narrative.overview: Loud where students decide, quiet where volunteers work. One token set across every surface; semantic color for status.
keyCharacteristics: One token set for every surface
Status is green/amber/red, never the accent
QR is pure black on pure white

rules.name: The Headline-Only Rule
rules.body: Burnt Clay on sand passes for large display type only. Body copy is Ink.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Not-Theme Rule
rules.body: Approved, pending and rejected are green, amber and red.

dos: Do read colors and fonts from tokens.
Do keep 44px tap targets on phone controls.
donts: Don't put the theme accent on status or scan results.
Don't tint or texture the ticket QR.
